title: Sidebar: Chats section below Projects
body: The old "History" section is now called "Chats" and sits right under your projects, with its own collapse arrow just like Projects.

title: Fixed sidebar search
body: Search was silently failing to show results if the Chats section was collapsed, and only searched within whichever project you had open. Search now always shows its results and looks across everything.

title: Sources panel now grouped by search
body: The right-hand sources panel now groups results by which search they came from, matching how they're already grouped above the chat, instead of one long mixed list.

title: No more delay after a quiet period
body: The model now stays loaded and ready instead of unloading after a few minutes of inactivity, so your first message after a break shouldn't have to wait for it to reload.

title: Settings page cleanup
body: Settings sections now have clearer visual separation. Removed Behavior and Conversation Data; Feedback is hidden until it's fully tested. Usage is now "Your usage", with real calendar dates instead of day names. Project icons now use a transparent background instead of a color swatch.

title: See the model's reasoning
body: For users who have it turned on, you can now expand and read the model's step-by-step reasoning behind a reply, not just the final answer.

title: Fixed replies drifting into gibberish
body: Fixed a bug where a long reply could drift away from real words into a chain of loosely related synonyms instead of actual sentences. Long replies read coherently all the way through now.

title: Fixed replies that could run away and freeze chat
body: Found and fixed a bug where a single reply could occasionally spiral into an endless repetitive loop, tying up the server until someone restarted it by hand. Replies are now automatically capped so this can't happen again.

title: Download Wrike attachments from chat
body: Attachments Jabber finds on a Wrike task can now be downloaded straight from the conversation.

title: Live Sage (ERP) lookups
body: For users with it turned on, Jabber can now look up real data in Sage and bring it into its answer instead of only working from what you typed.

title: Images in chat
body: You can now paste or attach images directly into a conversation.
